messages:
Mai: Quick sync on embeddings preview — prototyping a 'condensed rows' toggle + export behavior for large batches. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123/vector-export-proto. Main goals: clarity on selection, a11y, and export limits. Lex: Condensed rows look good. Proposal: collapse metadata behind chevron, keep main text single line, move score pill inline to avoid wrap. Add a tiny divider instead of floating pill. Sam: a11y nits: ensure checkboxes keep 32px targets (increase hit area). Add `aria-label` for table and `aria-sort` on score. Use live region notices when exports are queued. Olivia: Export copy: change CTA to "Export selected vectors (.csv)". Add secondary "Export all results (up to 10,000)" and a persistent banner when selecting everything: "You selected 4,300 results — exports >500 are queued." Mai: Banner text: "Large export queued. You'll get an email when ready. Streaming CSV for <=500 rows." Confirm >5,000 rows. Lex: Keyboard: support arrow nav and `x` to toggle selection; add `?` help modal for shortcuts to avoid surprises. Range select with Shift+click. Sam: For queued export announce via `
Export queued. Notification will be emailed.
`. Ensure focus returns after modal close. Olivia: Offer CSV and JSONL in modal; checkbox for "Include embeddings (base64)" with size warning. Provide a small schema link. design-bot: PR #530 opened: compact rows + export modal. CI: accessibility-lint passed, e2e flaky on selection persistence. https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/530 Mai: Action list: Lex update Figma (row/pill/chevron) EOD; Sam write a11y checklist 48h; Olivia draft export modal copy & schema 48h; Backend: queued export job + status endpoint. Follow-up next Tue. :thumbsup:
